title: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: the overview
caption: Five parts: a flip on a mark with its note, the same answer keeping the same mark, a re-grade that makes a new run from stored answers, a run against the run before, and a conversation copied for the file.

cards.title: F126.4 Correct the judge, grade again, compare
cards.text: A person says where the judge was wrong, grades a run again after changing the file, and sees whether the agent got better or worse.

cards.title: A flip
cards.text: On a criterion's mark, with a one-line note. Your answer counts from then on, and Undo puts it back.

cards.title: Same answer, same mark
cards.text: Where the answer and the criterion are word for word the same, the mark and its flip carry over.

cards.title: Re-grade
cards.text: A new run from a run's answers. The judge is asked only for what changed, into the live run's recording.

cards.title: Better or worse
cards.text: Every run against the run before: more or fewer passed, what now passes, the last 8 runs.

cards.title: Copy as conversation
cards.text: A conversation of a run, copied as a block the eval file reads, to paste and change.
